decisions.title: Auto-pause dp-dev when idle
decisions.risk: Short outages if pause rules misfire.
decisions.assumption: Paused outside quarter-days 1-3 only.

decisions.title: Pause dp-dev, move to Zurich
decisions.risk: Cost impact unknown; needs finance decision.
decisions.assumption: Only CO2 changes from CH grid; price not in data.

decisions.title: Auto-pause dp-prod when idle
decisions.risk: Could interrupt nightly and month-end jobs.
decisions.assumption: Pause only outside all listed production windows.

decisions.title: Run gpu-ml on demand
decisions.risk: Training availability must stay intact.
decisions.assumption: Keeps quarterly training days and current usage time.

decisions.title: Run gpu-ml in Zurich
decisions.risk: Cost impact unknown; needs finance decision.
decisions.assumption: Only CO2 changes from CH grid; price not in data.

decisions.title: Decommission forgotten servers
decisions.risk: Possible hidden dependency or retention need.
decisions.assumption: Owners confirm no business use or legal retention.

decisions.title: Run test servers in office hours
decisions.risk: May affect overnight jobs or rare user access.
decisions.assumption: Nightly jobs can move or are unused.

decisions.title: Rightsize vm-test after go-live
decisions.risk: Needs project owner to confirm post-go-live sizing.
decisions.assumption: Temporary project capacity can be reduced now.

decisions.title: Remove inactive CRM platform seats
decisions.risk: Verify no critical users before renewal.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at contract renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Chat tool seats
decisions.risk: Check team coverage and shared accounts.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive ChatGPT Team seats
decisions.risk: AI usage may spike for a few users.
decisions.assumption: Only unused seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Design tool seats
decisions.risk: Confirm designers still covered during peaks.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats removed at renewal only.

decisions.title: Remove inactive E-signature seats
decisions.risk: Legal signing capacity must not drop.
decisions.assumption: Inactive seats removed at renewal only.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Knowledge base seats
decisions.risk: Check editorial and admin access needs.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Microsoft Copilot seats
decisions.risk: Ensure power users keep access.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Note-taking tool seats
decisions.risk: Confirm meeting and sales coverage.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Project management seats
decisions.risk: Project leads may need temporary access.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Project scheduling seats
decisions.risk: Scheduling admins may be seasonal users.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Survey tool seats
decisions.risk: Very high reduction; confirm campaign needs.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Ticket system seats
decisions.risk: Support coverage must remain unchanged.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Remove inactive Video conferencing tool seats
decisions.risk: External meeting hosts need capacity.
decisions.assumption: Only inactive seats removed at renewal.

decisions.title: Draft texts: default small model
decisions.risk: Text quality may drop for sensitive drafts.
decisions.assumption: Applied only where reviewers accept simpler outputs.

decisions.title: Summarise: default small model
decisions.risk: Missing nuance in long or technical summaries.
decisions.assumption: Users can switch to large model when needed.

decisions.title: Translate: default small model
decisions.risk: Terminology errors on legal or client texts.
decisions.assumption: Large model remains available for critical translations.

decisions.title: Classify: default small model
decisions.risk: Past script bug was one-off; quality must be checked.
decisions.assumption: Exclude the fixed bug traffic from recurring savings.

decisions.title: Remove stale tables after review
decisions.risk: Some old tables may still have business or legal value.
decisions.assumption: Owner confirms retention needs before deletion.

decisions.title: Skip unchanged nightly builds
decisions.risk: Very low; only empty builds are skipped.
decisions.assumption: Change detection is reliable.

decisions.title: Run reports on request only
decisions.risk: Some stakeholders may still expect automatic delivery.
decisions.assumption: Unopened reports can be replaced by ad hoc runs.

decisions.title: Shorten logs where allowed
decisions.risk: May hinder incident review or compliance checks.
decisions.assumption: Keep exceptions for regulated or debugging logs.

extra_measures.title: Prevent CI reruns
extra_measures.description: Reduce automatic reruns unless the cause is clear.
extra_measures.risk: May slow troubleshooting after flaky failures.
extra_measures.assumption: Reruns are mostly avoidable and not compliance-critical.

extra_measures.title: Purge tmp schema
extra_measures.description: Delete temporary tables in tmp schema after validation.
extra_measures.risk: Temporary objects may still be needed by some jobs.
extra_measures.assumption: tmp schema data is safe to remove after review.

ai_footprint.formula: eq = output (incl. reasoning) + 0.1 × uncached input + 0.01 × cached input (× 0.25 small models); kWh = eq / 1000 × Wh per 1000 tokens (factors.yaml ai_tokens: 0.1 / 0.5 / 2.0); CO2 = kWh × EU grid (0.150 / 0.213 / 0.300 kg/kWh)
ai_footprint.source: measured during this run (token usage returned by the API)
